BlockChainBaccarat.detail: Blockchain baccarat - a card game with Fairness Guarantees, the new breakthrough with blockchain technology. The game uses 8 decks of cards (416 cards, excluding the Joker). There are 7 betting options, and Punters can bet on one or more betting options shown on the game table.

BigSmall.detail: Big Small or commonly known as Sicbo or Tai Sai, is a game played with three dice. The players place bets and predict the total points of the three dice are BIG or SMALL.

Baccarat.detail: Baccarat is one of the most often-played card games in the casino. The game is played with one standard 52-card deck (excluding the Joker). There are 7 betting options and Punters can bet on one or more betting options shown on the game table.
